title: S. palustris Leaves Sampling and RNA Extraction
author: Maria Stefanie Dwiyanti
materials: Add leaf materials into mortar. Wipe RNAlater left on leaves using kimwipe. The amount of leaves from the 50 ml tubes. 6 ml extraction buffer or more will be enough for the leaves.

steps.title: Sample Collection and Preservation
steps.instruction: Collect young leaves without fiber and preserve them in RNAlater solution.

substeps.instruction: Prepare RNAlater (Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #AM7020) in 50 ml falcon tubes.
Cut leaves into small pieces and add to the RNAlater solution, maintaining a maximum leaf-to-solution proportion of 1:5.
Store 50 ml tubes inside an ice box/ice packs for shipment.
If storing at 4°C, do so for no more than 1 month to avoid leaves turning reddish, which hinders RNA extraction.

steps.title: Sample Pulverization
steps.instruction: Grind the plant material into a fine powder using liquid nitrogen.

substeps.instruction: Add liquid nitrogen to a mortar.
Quickly crush plant material to a fine powder, continuously adding liquid nitrogen to keep the material frozen.

steps.title: Initial RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract RNA using CTAB buffer and chloroform:isoamylalcohol.

substeps.instruction: Warm CTAB extraction buffer to 65°C using a water bath or beaker with warm water.
Add 1 spatula of sample powder to 1 ml of warm CTAB buffer in 2 ml tubes.
Vortex to mix, ensuring no clumps; add more CTAB buffer if necessary.
Add 700 µL chloroform:isoamylalcohol (24:1) and vortex to mix.
Centrifuge at 15,000 rpm for 10 min at 4°C.
Transfer the upper phase to a new 1.5 ml tube.

steps.title: Phase Purification
steps.instruction: Repeat the extraction process to ensure the upper phase is greenish-clear.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the addition of chloroform:isoamylalcohol, centrifugation (15,000 rpm, 10 min, 4°C), and transfer of the upper phase twice more (for a total of 3 times).

steps.title: RNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the RNA using Lithium Chloride (LiCl).

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of 8 M LiCl to the tubes and mix by inverting several times.
Place tubes in a styrofoam box with ice and store overnight at 4°C (ideally 12-15 hours, before the solution turns red).
Centrifuge at 15,000 rpm for 45 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant using a pipette to leave a white-transparent pellet.

steps.title: Pellet Washing and Dissolution
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet and dissolve the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL of 80% cold ethanol.
Centrifuge at 15,000 rpm for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the solution using a pipette and open tubes on ice to dry the pellet for a few minutes.
Dissolve the pellet in 270 µL DNase-RNAse free water (pellets from up to 6 tubes can be combined into 1 tube).

steps.title: DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove DNA contamination from the RNA sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 27 µL of 10× DNase I buffer, 2 µL of DNase I (RNase free), and 1 µL of RNase inhibitor to the solution.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: RNA Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the RNA using phenol-chloroform extractions.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 µl of phenol:chloroform:isoamylalcohol (25:24:1) and invert tubes to mix.
Centrifuge at 15,000 rpm for 3 min at 4°C.
Transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 ml tube.
Add 300 µL of chloroform:isoamylalcohol, invert to mix, and centrifuge at 15,000 rpm for 3 min at 4°C.
Transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 ml tube.

steps.title: Final Precipitation and Recovery
steps.instruction: Perform final ethanol precipitation to recover pure RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 30 µL of 3M NaOAc and 700 µl of 99.5% ethanol (4°C) to the supernatant and mix well by inverting.
Store at -30°C overnight.
Centrifuge at 15,000 rpm for 45 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant using a pipette to leave a white-transparent pellet.
Add 100 µL of 80% ethanol (4°C) and centrifuge at 15,000 rpm for 3 min at 4°C.
Dissolve the pellet in 50 µL of water.

steps.title: Quality Control and Storage
steps.instruction: Verify RNA quality and store the sample.

substeps.instruction: Quantify RNA using Nanodrop and check quality via gel electrophoresis.
Store RNA at -80°C.
